title: Escalate alerts by deterministic once, repeated, and persistent rules
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `alert_escalation`: occurrence counts map to log → surface → propose with per-alert overrides; unordered thresholds are refused. No model participates. Decision-plane policy already separates model proposal from code decision (`fangore_decision_plane_policy`). Tracks MH-PA-06[^insp-pa-06].
implementation: `AlertEscalationPolicy` / `AlertOccurrenceCounter` via product verb `alert_escalation` (`cli_policy_verbs`). Walk-bag `in`/`out` carry policy inputs and ladder outcomes.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `alert_escalation`; expects ladder / override_ladder / counter_walk and unordered_refused.
